workflow.debug: Diagnose a failing run via the workflow-debugger subagent
workflow.delegate: Hand off explicitly to one of the four workflow specialists
workflow.refactor: Restructure a subgraph via the workflow-refactorer subagent
workflow.run: Run the workflow (or from a specific step). Requires approval.
workflow.suggest: Propose one next node to add (no auto-apply)
workflow.validate: Run local validation and ask the agent to fix any issues
